management_notes: Management has maintained a consistent drill program at Black Raven through 2025–2026 and executed the TSXV-approved Golden Baie option agreement (March 2026, ~1,597 claims, ~400 sq km along a 30 km antimony-gold corridor), demonstrating disciplined land acquisition in a focused critical-mineral corridor. Public disclosure on insider ownership percentages remains limited; no insider buying events have been identified in available 2026 filings. The team is operationally credible given the quality of intercepts published to date, but there is no visible evidence of exceptional founder skin-in-the-game or a prior discovery-to-development track record on a comparable deposit.
geology_notes: Black Raven Project (Central Newfoundland) has returned high-grade antimony intercepts along approximately 800m of demonstrated strike: 19.23% Sb over 1.40m at Frost Cove North and 7.25% Sb over 1.98m near the Southern Shaft (assay results announced August 28, 2026 — the most recent material disclosure as of September 8, 2026). The Spring 2026 program also discovered a new polymetallic system at PC Pond (0.78% Cu, 61.2 g/t Ag over 6.22m), adding geological optionality. Black Raven is located 100km north of the historic Beaver Brook Antimony Mine — North America's largest primary antimony producer when operating — providing a strong geological analog. No NI 43-101 resource estimate has been published; the project remains in early-stage delineation. Intercept grades are genuinely high but intervals are narrow, and the mineralised system extent is still being mapped.
capital_notes: Shares issued stand at 316,681,940 — a heavy count for a pre-resource explorer. Fully diluted at 342,756,940 includes 2,625,000 warrants and 23,450,000 stock options (~8.2% combined overhang). Strike prices and expiry dates were not captured in the April 2026 MD&A extraction. No flow-through tranches were detected in the extracted filing data (cap-table sourced from interim MD&A dated April 29, 2026). The large share base compresses per-share discovery value and will limit re-rating upside until a NI 43-101 resource provides a NAV anchor for any financing.
catalyst_notes: August 28, 2026 assay results (Frost Cove North + PC Pond polymetallic discovery) are the most recent completed catalyst; as of September 8, 2026 no additional announcements have been filed. Pending near-term catalysts include: (1) additional 2026 drill and trench assay results from Black Raven delineation program; (2) first-pass trenching and geophysical survey data from the newly optioned Golden Baie property; (3) macro: China antimony export controls (imposed 2024) continue to underpin North American supply urgency, and US-China trade tensions in September 2026 keep strategic mineral premiums elevated. A maiden NI 43-101 resource estimate would be a transformative re-rating event but is likely 12–18+ months away given current program stage.
acquisition_notes: No NI 43-101 resource estimate exists, making P/NAV calculation impossible. The antimony critical-mineral designation and Newfoundland jurisdiction provide a strategic premium that may attract attention from battery-metals or defence-supply-chain acquirers, but without a resource any M&A transaction remains highly speculative. The share count (316.7M issued) limits per-share transaction premiums. Comparable antimony asset transactions in Canada are rare, leaving benchmark multiples thin. A strategic buyer would be acquiring optionality on high-grade drill results, not a defined resource — typical valuation in this scenario is heavily discounted.
analyst_summary: Churchill Resources is a pre-resource antimony explorer in Central Newfoundland with a credible critical-mineral thesis: China controls over 80% of global primary antimony supply and imposed export controls in 2024, creating structural North American supply urgency that remains unresolved as of September 2026. The Black Raven Project has returned genuinely high-grade intercepts (19.23% Sb over 1.40m, Frost Cove North) along 800m of demonstrated strike, and the Spring 2026 program added a new copper-silver polymetallic system at PC Pond. No new material company announcements have been filed since the August 28, 2026 assay release. The stock is trading near $0.06 CAD (as of late August 2026). The thesis rests almost entirely on discovery upside and macro antimony supply deficit dynamics. The structural bear case remains: no NI 43-101 resource, a heavy share count (316.7M issued, 342.8M fully diluted), and limited per-share re-rating capacity until a resource provides a NAV anchor. WATCH until a maiden resource estimate changes the valuation framework. Retail investors should size for pre-resource exploration risk.
